crossRefs.note: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.
Yahweh sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, and the leaders and captains, in the camp of the king of…
In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to Yahweh; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

translations.web: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
translations.bsb: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
translations.kjv: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
translations.asv: The righteous cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.
